why: The student reads the e in 6.02e23 as Euler's number (6.02 times e to the 23rd), which is the documented ExponentIsPower misconception; in Java the e means times ten to the power, so the number is 6.02 x 10^23.

concepts.quote: 6.02e23 is 6.02 times e to the power 23.
concepts.why: This matches the wrong rule that E23 means e to the 23rd; Java reads it as times 10 to the 23rd.
